data.body: Reverted to open: this umbrella ticket spans multiple independent causes. Track A (test-merge-to-main*.sh) closed via PR #221 (aa4f-13b3 / 42bd-5b9b). Sub-issues remaining: test-write-cycle-ledger.sh intermittent (separate investigation needed; uses mktemp -d so the /tmp race is disproved), test-gha-scanner SIGPIPE (Track C), test-dso-shim-subdir-dispatch TIMEOUT (Track D).
